desc: Reduce the problem to finding the longest palindromic suffix of S, equivalently the longest prefix of reverse(S) that is a suffix of S.
Implement the KMP prefix function for P = S[::-1] in O(n) time using bytes.
Scan S with KMP state q, using fallback while q > 0 and (q == n or P[q] != c), and do not reset a full match, so q is the desired suffix length.
Construct the answer as S + S[:n-q][::-1] and write it to stdout.
Test on samples (ABC, Z, TREE) and edge cases such as single character, already palindrome, all same characters, and small random brute-force checks.
